cusip_pair_in_words: the pair is the one the drivers formed: ib442_prepare.py:81-82 sec_ticker[cusip] (most frequent ticker/symbol the holdings state that is not the cusip itself; built in ib442_phase1.py:97-99 from the Ticker and Symbol columns of rows whose CUSIP column is the security), restricted to the three nine-pair classes (ib452_tickers.py:23-25); plus ib150_overlap_tickers.py:52-57 overlap[cusip]['ticker'] for the nine admitted pairs.  Where a symbol has more than one cusip the request carries the lexicographically first and the count is stated.
